owner.description: Owner identifier to query metrics for; accepts nameservice names (resolved to addresses) or bech32 addresses directly. Resolution occurs server-side before computing metrics.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryMetricsReq.title: Query Metrics Request
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryMetricsReq.description: QueryMetricsRequest retrieves storage usage metrics for an owner. Metrics include total bytes stored, calculated stake requirements, and current stake amount.

owner.description: Resolved account address that owns the storage entries.

total_bytes.description: Total number of bytes consumed by all storage entries for this owner.

min_stake_amount.description: Minimum stake required in udys for current storage usage (total_bytes × storage_stake_multiple).

current_stake_amount.description: Owner's current total delegated stake in udys across all validators.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryMetricsRes.title: Query Metrics Response
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryMetricsRes.description: Response containing storage metrics and stake information for an owner.
